gaps.title: Status page runs off the bottom of the screen
gaps.detail: A grown character's Status page was taller than the 720-tall frame: measured 729 design px tall at top=96, bottom=825, with the footer line (arrows somebody else - Cancel to go back) at y=800, entirely off screen. A child could not see how to leave the page or how to look at the next character. Fix: lay the page out so it always fits (smaller status type, spells in two columns, Next level and In a fight moved under the numbers), and measure the real height after every content change and slide the window up if it would ever overflow.

events.note: Measured in the running build both in demos/P13.html and /index.html. Before: window height 729 design px at top 96, bottom 825, footer bottom 800 (80 px below the screen). After: Act II Bram 565 tall, bottom 661; Act III Bram 565/661; the Act III mage (11 spells, 5 kit slots) 576 tall, bottom 672 - and the fit guard would slide any taller page up to keep it inside 706. __DQ.state().menu.statusFit now reports {hU, top, bottom} and both scenarios assert bottom <= 720 for four different characters. Footer visible in every Status screenshot.

gaps.title: The little 3D portrait is empty on the second visit to Status
gaps.detail: Open Status once and the portrait renders. Leave it, do anything else in the menu and open Status again and the portrait frame is EMPTY - just the blue panel and a shadow blob. Cause: portraitEl() built a NEW canvas element every visit while the WebGLRenderer stayed bound to the first one, so the context painted into a detached node. Fix: keep one canvas for the life of the renderer and move it into the new frame.

events.note: One canvas is now kept on PORTRAIT.canvas for the life of the renderer and moved into each new frame; portraitDestroy clears it with the context. Verified by shooting Status a SECOND time in the same menu session (scenarios/P13.json step 13b, after Items, Equip and Spells have each opened and closed): __DQ.state().menu.portrait.live is true and the screenshot shots/P13-r8/16-13b-status-act-three.png shows the model. The same shot in shots/P13-r4 (before) is an empty blue panel.

gaps.title: Bram is drawn as a six-year-old in Acts II and III
gaps.detail: portraitLook() hardcoded age 6 for the hero, so the Status portrait showed the boy even at Level 24 with a wife and twins. Fix: pick the age from the member (age/act) or, failing that, from the company he keeps - Rowan and Linnet mean Act III, Papa walking as a guest means Act I.

events.note: portraitLook now calls heroAge(m): the member's own age or act if it has one, else Rowan or Linnet in the company means 26 and Halvard walking as a guest means 6, else 16. Verified by eye: shots/P13-r8/16-13b-status-act-three.png is a grown, broad-shouldered Bram at Level 24, while shots/P13-idx2/04-04-status.png (Act I, Halvard a guest, Level 1) is still the round-headed boy.

gaps.title: A long item name runs out through the side of the window
gaps.detail: In Status > Wearing, the trinket The Sock of Considerable Power ran straight out through the right-hand border of the window and off the screen edge, because every row was white-space: nowrap. Fix: the label always reads in full and the value wraps inside its column; and the menu now reports a spill number per window so this is measurable.

events.note: The status label is now flex 0 1 auto and nowrap while the value is flex 1 1 auto and wraps. Verified: in shots/P13-r7 and r8 the trinket The Sock of Considerable Power wraps onto two lines inside the Wearing column with the window border intact, and the new __DQ.state().menu.fit report gives spill 0 for every open window in both the demo and /index.html (the real-game run reports over 0 and spill 0 for m-cmd, m-party, m-gold, m-slots, m-kit and m-stats together).

gaps.title: The Misc window covers the line that explains the setting
gaps.detail: Misc is the tallest list in the menu (six rows plus a title). At top 360 it reached y=692 and sat straight on top of the blurb window at bottom 24, so the one line that tells a child what How fast the words come actually means was 90 per cent hidden, with only the last two words (xt one.) peeking out from behind. Fix: sit the Misc list higher, and assert in the scenario that the Misc window bottom is above the blurb top.

events.note: Misc now opens at top 286 instead of 360. Measured from __DQ.state().menu.fit in the real game: m-misc top 286 bottom 620, m-blurb top 648 - so 28 design px of clear air between them, and scenarios/P13-index.json now asserts m-misc.bottom <= m-blurb.top. Both shots/P13-final/20-16-misc.png and shots/P13-idx-final/08-07-misc.png show the whole explanation line, where shots/P13-r0/17-16-misc.png showed only the tail of it.

Exact numbers from the real game after the fix: m-misc top 286 bottom 620, m-blurb top 635 bottom 696 - 15 design px of clear air, and both windows report over 0 and spill 0. (An earlier note said 648/28; 635/15 is what the build actually measures.)

gaps.title: Menu reads the fixture item table, not src/data/items.js
gaps.detail: src/ui/menu.js imports DATA from tests/battle/data.js, so the bag, Items and Equip windows show 58 fixture rows instead of the 73 canon rows in src/data/items.js (P21, now written). Measured in /index.html: Object.keys(Menu.items).length is 58 at boot; after calling (await import(/src/data/items.js)).install(ctx) it is 73, every row carries its own blurb and where, and the Equip window shows Copper Sword +11 with a green up-arrow 21 delta. Fix: in menu.js install(ctx) add import { ITEMS } from ../data/items.js and call Menu.useData({ items: ITEMS }) (the swap menu.js own header already promises). Then ITEM_WORDS can go, since every row has a blurb.

events.note: Re-measured from the P21 side and still open. At /index.html __DQ.state().items is null, so items.js install() never runs; src/main.js PLUGINS has no data/items.js entry and Menu.useData is never called. The bag therefore shows menu.js's own ITEM_WORDS copy, and 6 of its 17 lines have already drifted from items.js (sunbottle, retreat_bell, homing_feather, whiff_powder, seed_of_life, pot_lid). 41 of the 45 equippable rows fall through to describeGear: Copper Sword reads plus 11 Attack. Only Bram or Rowan can hold it, Mirror Shield reads plus 25 Defence with no word about reflecting Wobble and Snoozle. Note P13 #8, which I opened before spotting this one — it is the same defect with sharper numbers plus the shop case; the orchestrator should merge #8 into #6.

gaps.title: No way to see the keys you are carrying
gaps.detail: P30 gives the player a Rusty Key (found in the pot at the dead end in Puddlewick) which opens the two locked chests. Keys are not battle items so they are not in Roster.bag; treasure.js keeps them in its own ledger and reports them at __DQ.state().treasure.keys. A child therefore has no way to see that they are carrying a key, and no way to learn that the locked chest they could not open is now openable. Fix in src/ui/menu.js: add a Keys (or Important Items) row under Misc that reads the key list. The list is available as Treasure.state().keys from src/world/treasure.js, plus Treasure.KEYS for the display name and blurb of each one.

gaps.title: The bag and the shop show a stat line instead of the item's words, because menu.js keeps its own copy of the item table
gaps.detail: Filed against P13 because the file is src/ui/menu.js, whose own header says Menu.useData swaps in src/data/items.js 'the day P21 lands'. P21 has landed: src/data/items.js holds 73 rows, every one with a one-line blurb in voice, and it exports install(ctx) plus wire(Menu). Nothing calls either — src/main.js's PLUGINS list (transitions, dialogue, menu, hud, npc, encounter, battle.present, battle.scene, title) does not include data/items.js, so __DQ.state().items is null at /index.html and Menu.useData is never called. menu.js therefore keeps ITEMS = DATA.items from tests/battle/data.js (58 rows, 54 of them with no blurb at all) plus its own hand-copied ITEM_WORDS map of 17 lines. Measured at /index.html, walking the bag with __DQ.press('down') and reading .dq-blurb: Copper Sword -> '+11 Attack. Only Bram or Rowan can hold it.' (items.js: 'Your first real sword. It goes green if you sulk.'), Lucky Acorn -> '+8 Luck.', Chain Mail -> '+24 Defence, -2 Speed.', Mirror Shield -> '+25 Defence. Only Bram or Rowan can hold it.' — a 1,700 G shield whose whole point is reflecting Wobble and Snoozle, and the game never says so. All 45 equippable rows and 28 of the 73 rows overall have no words in the running game. The same happens in the shop: shots/P21-critic-d1/p22/03-03-buy-row2.png shows the Sling as '+7 Attack. Only Willow or Linnet can hold it.' instead of 'Willow can knock a pear off a wall with this at thirty paces.' The duplicate has already drifted: 6 of the 17 ITEM_WORDS lines no longer match items.js (sunbottle, retreat_bell, homing_feather, whiff_powder, seed_of_life, and pot_lid, where menu.js says 'Now it is a shield' and items.js says 'Barty would like it back'). Fix inside menu.js: import ITEMS from '../data/items.js' as the default table, delete ITEM_WORDS, and keep DATA.items only as the fallback if that import fails — itemWords() already prefers it.blurb, so the words appear the moment the table is right. Alternative one-liner for the integrator: add ['data.items', () => import('./data/items.js')] to src/main.js PLUGINS, which makes items.js call Menu.useData itself. Related: P14 gap about scene.js reading tests/battle/data.js is the same root — __DQ.give still refuses 12 of the 17 CANON section 6 key items (willows_ribbon, candle, music_box, papas_letter, mums_feather_hairpin, ambergarde_crest, tide_pearl, marsh_lily, stilt_boots, wolfscarf, emberbell, sunlarks_feather) and 3 of the 4 seeds.
